note_on_base: This task's branch forked from dev at 64b59ea46daae61e2946e4fbda24be25da78a4a7. A previous session on this branch already produced one anchor commit (660556a75a9d2abb44975f6617a279c9b2a1f37c, 'anchor seam extraction') that did the bulk of the assistant-provider, command-routing, and setter-injection extraction described in the task brief. This delivery is the continuation from that anchor commit: it closes the remaining gaps (persona-fleet projection duplication, management-ai route handlers still only assembled by main.py, a compose_bff_app control-mode-store clobber bug, the last main.py import in test_bff_rebalance_proposals.py, and the migration of test_main_composition_seam_extraction_002/003.py off dynamic main.py imports), adds the required regression suite, and republishes the live-scan counts.
summary: Extracted the assistant-provider, persona-fleet-projection, and management-AI-conversation seams that were still only assembled inside main.py so the six consumer test files can exercise them via core.app_factory.compose_bff_app() without importing main.py. Closed a bug where compose_bff_app() silently replaced any pre-wired assistant control-mode store with a fresh empty one on every call.

duplicate_definition_readback.result: Every symbol resolves to exactly one `def`/`async def` site (all in assistant/management_service.py except process_command in command_adapters/service.py). _process_command_stub is an alias assignment (`_process_command_stub = process_command`), not a second def. main.py contains zero of these definitions; it only imports them.

production_changes_summary: assistant/management_service.py: moved the persona-fleet projection implementation (_persona_fleet_runtime_matches, _project_persona_fleet_health, _project_persona_fleet_item_impl) here from main.py and made it the live default of get_project_persona_fleet_item(); moved the management-ai route handlers (bff_management_ai_audit, bff_assistant_provider_usage_summary, bff_management_ai_conversations, bff_management_ai_conversation, bff_management_ai_attachment) and the camel-alias helpers (_MANAGEMENT_CAMEL_KEY_RE, _management_camel_to_snake_key, _management_prune_camel_aliases) here from main.py; gave get_list_persona_records() a real default (personas.service._list_persona_records) instead of an always-empty stub.

core/app_factory.py: registered the five moved management-ai route handlers as resolvable default dependencies (mirroring the existing bff_management_nl_ask pattern) so compose_bff_app() mounts them without main.py; fixed mount_bff_routers() so the assistant control-mode store default checks assistant.management_service.get_assistant_control_mode_store() first instead of unconditionally constructing (and injecting) a brand-new empty ControlModeStore on every compose_bff_app() call, which was silently discarding any store a caller had already wired (this is what caused test_management_nl_context_pack_reflects_active_control_mode and 3 sibling tests to fail before this fix).
main.py: replaced each moved definition with an import from its new owner; no behavioral change to main.py's own composition/injection role.

test_bff_rebalance_proposals.py.root_cause: CapitalBffAuthorityHarness.__enter__ posts to /bff/capital-pools against a real, freshly-imported services.capital.main app and asserts response.json()['pool_id'] == 'pool-real'; in this sandbox that response body has no 'pool_id' key, before any BFF main.py or seam code from this task is even reached. This is an environment/service-boundary gap in the capital service test double available on this host, not a main.py-import regression -- it reproduces byte-for-byte on the unmodified base.

This delivery's main.py edits only remove code (net negative dead-function count: 83 dead functions on the unmodified base vs. 79 after this task's extraction, because 5 of the moved management-ai handlers were among the dead-code list); it introduces zero new lambda read_store seams (the 2 flagged lines pre-date this task and are untouched by this diff).
